CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.workspace_settings_get(p_workspace uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r text;
begin
 r:=zoi.settings_authorize(p_workspace,'identity',false);
 return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'workspace_id',p_workspace,'role',r,'identity',zoi.settings_section(p_workspace,'identity'),'voice',case when zoi.ops_role(p_workspace) is not null then zoi.settings_section(p_workspace,'voice') else null end);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ops_audit_list(p_workspace uuid, p_record uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE events jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR zoi.ops_role(p_workspace) IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized'; END IF;
 SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC),'[]') INTO events FROM (
 SELECT * FROM zoi.ops_audit WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND (p_record IS NULL OR record_id=p_record)
 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT greatest(least(p_limit,200),1)) a;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'events',events);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ai_profile_get(p_workspace uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if auth.uid() is null or zoi.ops_role(p_workspace) is null then raise exception 'not_authorized' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return coalesce((select to_jsonb(a) from zoi.ai_profiles a where workspace_id=p_workspace),'{}');
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.festival_actor(p_workspace uuid, p_manage boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor uuid;role text;
begin
 role:=zoi.ops_role(p_workspace);if auth.uid() is null or coalesce(role,'') not in('owner','admin','editor') or (p_manage and role not in('owner','admin')) then raise exception 'festival_permission_denied' using errcode='42501';end if;select id into actor from zoi.user_profiles where auth_user_id=auth.uid();return actor;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.football_actor(p_workspace uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare actor uuid;begin if auth.uid() is null or coalesce(zoi.ops_role(p_workspace),'') not in('owner','admin') then raise exception 'football_permission_denied' using errcode='42501';end if;select id into actor from zoi.user_profiles where auth_user_id=auth.uid();if actor is null then raise exception 'football_permission_denied';end if;return actor;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.property_actor(p_workspace uuid)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.festival_placement_operator(p_workspace uuid, p_event uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid;scopes jsonb;placements jsonb;
BEGIN actor:=zoi.festival_placement_authorize(p_workspace,p_event,false,false);SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY configuration),'[]') INTO scopes FROM zoi.festival_placement_scopes s WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND event_id=p_event;SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY updated_at DESC),'[]') INTO placements FROM zoi.festival_placements p WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND event_id=p_event;RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'scopes',scopes,'placements',placements,'can_manage',zoi.ops_role(p_workspace) IN('owner','admin'),'artwork_source','external_image');END $function$
